title: 2015 Nissan Tsuru vs. 2016 Nissan Versa
summary: An IIHS car-to-car crash test pitting a 2015 Nissan Tsuru, sold in Mexico, against a 2016 Nissan Versa, sold in the US. It is a 40 mph, 50 percent overlap collision that shows how safety standards differ between markets.
why: Cited as a stark demonstration of how much car safety has improved and how regulation differs between countries.

quote.text: Here's a crash test between a 2015 Nissan Tsuru, the least expensive sedan sold by Nissan in Mexico, and a 2016 Nissan Versa
